research_question: Under the exact fixed Tongyi/Qwen-DR deployment used by PASTE, compare a constrained Murakkab-style reactive DAG executor with PASTE without granting either treatment a different model, hardware, workflow, capacity, or request information.

common_frontend.description: Every cell must traverse the same typed declarative DAG and registry. Only the execution backend changes.

constrained_murakkab.optimizer_expected_result: select the sole fixed executable workflow
constrained_murakkab.runtime: dependency-respecting reactive dispatch of ready nodes

forbidden_treatment_differences: using PASTE top_k as a Murakkab mechanism

cells.label: Murakkab-fixed
cells.description: The singleton executable DAG is dispatched only after dependencies and authoritative invocations are ready.

required_headline_contrasts: M versus S: same native-FCFS runtime, isolating PASTE causal lookahead
M versus P: constrained fixed-DAG endpoint versus full PASTE

primary_realistic.authoritative_url_source: the fixed Tongyi model selects from the current visible search response
primary_realistic.paste_predictor: checksummed rank mapper trained only on a disjoint pre-experiment role and late-bound to the current response

controlled_upper_bound.interpretation: perfect-prediction live queue/serving mechanism upper bound only

primary_metrics: paired per-source mean task end-to-end latency
task p50, p95, and p99 latency
SLO violation rate for one absolute deadline frozen from development only
LLM and exposed search/visit wait decomposition
actual HTTP attempts and tool worker service seconds

resource_claim_boundary.energy_claim_requires: NVML integration over the identical task-release-to-last-completion window on all four GPUs
resource_claim_boundary.cost_claim_requires: an explicit fixed-deployment charging model declared before execution

evidence_discipline.existing_formal_v9_status: retrospective reference only; it was observed before this protocol and its A cell must not be relabeled Murakkab
evidence_discipline.confirmatory_requirement: implement and freeze the shared DAG frontend, code hashes, estimator, cell orders, and a new source set disjoint from all development and formal-v2-v9 workloads before the first performance run
